scope: Scientific nonidentity audit of IDEA000036, IDEA000037, IDEA000039, IDEA000040 and the current IA f69 question. Duplicate-search output is lexical navigation only.

comparisons.target_unit: complete diagram wholes across repeated visual units; stage/state plus changing local owner
comparisons.binding: independent stage/state and owner annotations; unavailable
comparisons.falsifier: held same-stage/state units fail to share the form beyond owner baseline, or forms remain one-to-one with owners
comparisons.against_36: IDEA000036 tests figure-associated labels tracking apparatus/material state versus biography/patient identity. IDEA000039 removes figure/biography and tests repeated diagram components/states under owner substitution; related covariance logic remains, so an explicit related_not_equivalent review is appropriate.
comparisons.against_37: IDEA000037 tests class/slot/system-entry recurrence versus unique member/name or ordinal recovery. IDEA000039 tests stage/state recurrence across repeated machine-like units; it does not predict a slot/class or ordinal. Related, not exact duplicate.
comparisons.against_IA_f69: IA tests repeated OKEOD in one f69 radial schedule against unique names and LONG/SHORT polarity. IDEA000039 requires cross-unit state/owner covariance; f69 recurrence alone cannot satisfy it. No duplicate.

comparisons.target_unit: complete candidate occurrences with treatment-mode/position, figure identity, and material state
comparisons.rival_exclusion: person/figure or material reference versus procedural mode marker
comparisons.binding: independent treatment-mode, figure-owner, and material-state annotations; unavailable
comparisons.falsifier: candidate tracks one person/material across changing modes, or no held treatment-mode interaction after controls
comparisons.against_36: IDEA000036 asks state/material covariance versus biography/patient identity in figure labels. IDEA000040 asks treatment-mode covariance while explicitly controlling figure and material; the decision target is procedural mode, not personified material. Shared source-family logic warrants related_not_equivalent review.
comparisons.against_37: Different unit, rival, and falsifier; no substantive identity beyond generic repeated-form testing.
comparisons.against_IA_f69: IA is an Astro recurrence/polarity question about OKEOD and radial layout. IDEA000040 concerns treatment-mode annotations in admitted visual/textual records; no overlap.

source_contract_check.GDT214: The source reports four parallel lifting bays and explicitly presents component/state keys as a historical alternative; it supplies no Voynich count or semantic gold. The proposal's only count-like observation is the quoted four-bay comparator, not a coded manuscript result.
source_contract_check.GDT210: The report calls six bath axes and one secondary axis post-hoc leads and explicitly claims no composite score or p-value. IDEA000040 therefore has no empirical count endpoint; its availability remains unknown.
source_contract_check.IA_f69: The IA record explicitly limits the OKEOD result to recurrence challenging injective names and fixed layout polarity; it does not choose state/value meaning or provide independent bindings.

evidence.quote:
Met 55.121.11 is the closest readable technical-rendering comparator yet.  It
combines a water source, repeated lifting components, a driving animal, shafts
and wheels, and numerous compact marks beside parts.  The reverse is
especially informative: four parallel lifting bays sit under a shared drive,
showing that repeated visual units can be components or stages of one machine
rather than four independent named objects.

## Architectural consequence

This establishes a historically real alternative for q13 graphical text:
some diagram-local strings could function as references into explanatory prose
or as component/state keys, not as ordinary object names.  That alternative is
more compatible with q13's mixed labels/prose and weak one-object ownership
than a naive label dictionary.

Across the transparent post-hoc comparison, 6 axes are specific
leads for the bath theory and 1 is a secondary lead for the
alchemical/hydraulic theory. No composite score or p-value is claimed.
